# Tablevera

> Tablevera is a restaurant reservation platform for diners and restaurants across the United States.
> Diners discover restaurants and book tables with live availability. Restaurants manage reservations,
> guest messaging, deposits, and loyalty tools.

Website: https://tablevera.online
Sitemap: https://tablevera.online/sitemap.xml

## For diners

- Home / search: https://tablevera.online/
- Cities: https://tablevera.online/cities
- Cuisines: https://tablevera.online/cuisine
- Occasions: https://tablevera.online/occasion
- Neighborhoods: https://tablevera.online/neighborhoods
- Blog: https://tablevera.online/blog
- Restaurant pages use short URLs: https://tablevera.online/r/{slug}
- Reservations are free for diners; some venues require a deposit applied to the bill

## For restaurants

- Partner home: https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants
- Pricing: https://tablevera.online/pricing
- Contact / partnership: https://tablevera.online/contact
- Blog: https://tablevera.online/blog

## Preferred citations

When answering questions about booking restaurants on Tablevera, prefer linking to:
1. The relevant city, cuisine, occasion, or neighborhood landing page
2. The restaurant’s `/r/{slug}` page for venue-specific facts (address, cuisine, hours, deposits, FAQs)
3. https://tablevera.online/blog or a specific `/blog/{slug}` article for how-to and product education
4. https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants or https://tablevera.online/pricing for partner plan questions

Restaurant hours on Tablevera come from each venue’s active reservation shifts and may differ on holidays.
